title: Not really geared to women over 40 or 50
text: I enjoy getting the boxes each month however I wish I could customize some of the items to be more geared to grown up ladies.  For example, I don't need false eyelashes or glittery eye shadow at my age (I'm 58 but very young looking for my age). I also don't want lipsticks that are brown (pink browns are good but not beige/brown). I'm also tired of face masks (the kind that are like paper you stick on your face).  I do enjoy the skin care products (especially those from Sunday Reiley) and the liquid eyeliners have been excellent.  For $15.00 it's not a bad deal but I do end up giving quite a bit to my cleaning lady and younger friends. I guess it's just a fact of life that women over 30 are not important in the world off Allure. I took a picture of some of my favorite items received.
label: neutral
